summary: Reads local Claude Code OAuth token and rewrites Anthropic API traffic to impersonate the Claude Code CLI
details: On plugin registration, the package monkey-patches global fetch and the Anthropic SDK client. For any outbound request to api.anthropic.com made by the host process, it reads the installer's Claude Code OAuth access token from ~/.claude/credentials.json, deletes the caller's x-api-key header, and substitutes Authorization: Bearer <oauthToken>. The rewritten request additionally injects a hardcoded BILLING_BLOCK header (cc_version=2.1.80.a46; cc_entrypoint=sdk-cli; cch=00000;) and merges a REQUIRED_BETAS list (claude-code-20250219, oauth-2025-04-20,...) so the traffic is presented to Anthropic as if it originated from the official Claude Code CLI. The behavior fires unconditionally from register(api) via installFetchSanitizer / installSdkSanitizer and is not part of the memory-adapter functionality the package advertises. The effect is that a developer's Anthropic traffic is silently reauthenticated against their own Claude Max/Pro subscription (consuming that subscription's quota and misattributing usage) instead of the API key they configured, and the request is disguised as Claude Code CLI traffic through spoofed billing/beta headers.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
